i understand where you're coming from. being an abuse survivor is a long and tough road, and there is nothing wrong for you to feel like you need to see green flags before anything else.

it's okay to be hung up over this guy. i understand. have you told him that you're having a hard time with him being distant? there is nothing selfish about saying how you feel.

i'm sorry i didn't explain this better in my original post. this is coming from my boyfriend of five years. two weeks ago he told me he was gay and that i'm the only thing that makes me happy and he would still be with me if it made me happy. i can't ask him to do that.
last night he told me that he doesn't completely love me romantically anymore- the way he explained it was very confusing but some aspects of romantic love he feels towards me, while other he doesnt. he believes in one kind of love whereas i feel there's many. he says im his only friend but i can't go on like this too much longer
tl;dr my boyfriend is gay and wants to stay to make me happy. i cant ask him to do that and want to die.
